42.note: Note rewritten in adjudication: the reader's original note claimed this opener was keyed as a plain ASCII digit "per the precedent recorded for 2-034 in keying_spec.md §2.10", and said the half-open-pairing check flagging it would be correct. All three parts are wrong. §2.10 is marked SETTLED and says key the Unicode superscript and never the ASCII digit; gt/ocr/chukchi-2-034.xml keys its own opener "¹ See Chapter XIV.", the opposite of the cited precedent; and the half-open pairing is the defect that check exists to catch, not a sanctioned pattern. The text itself is right — U+00B9, as verified — so the note described output the reader did not produce. Recorded because a confident rationale attached to correct text is how correct text gets undone at review.
